you purchase securities in this offering, assuming no sale of any pre-funded warrants and no exercise of the common warrants issued in
connection with this offering or the Placement Agent Warrants issued as compensation to the Placement Agent, your ownership interest
will be immediately diluted to the extent of the difference between the combined public offering price per share of our Common Stock
and accompanying common warrants in this offering and the as adjusted net tangible book value per share of our Common Stock immediately
after giving effect to this offering. Our
net tangible book value as of June 30, 2026 was approximately $4.2 million, or approximately $0.90 per share of our Common Stock. Our
